title: PERM Fake Job Ads defraud Americans to secure green cards fo
summary: A 2007 clip in which immigration attorneys describe how they help employers run classified ads designed not to find qualified American applicants, so they can secure green cards for H-1B workers. It is presented as an exposé of the PERM process.
why: HN commenters in H-1B debates post it as evidence that the labor-market test is gamed with fake job ads.

quote.text: the goal is to not hire a domestic worker, and getting a suitably experienced domestic worker applying for the job is considered a failure state of the process.
